pose_constraints.posture: Strictly vertical 'Pillar' stance; chest out, head held high with a curious tilt.
pose_constraints.orientation: Direct 0-degree head-on view to compress the body width into a 280px vertical column.
pose_constraints.body_logic: Arms are tucked neatly at the sides. The tail is hidden directly behind the legs.
pose_constraints.framing_note: The high-spined hump peaks at the top of the silhouette.

character_details.expression: Big, soulful eyes with a gentle 'what's that?' look; a soft, rounded snout with a tiny closed-mouth smile.
character_details.texture: Clean, 'squishy' pebbled skin. Saturated colors: Deep forest green with a bright sunny-orange gradient on the hump.

environmental_details.ground: Soft-focus damp silt with a few stylized, bright green ferns.
environmental_details.lighting: High-key 'Golden Hour' rim-lighting; a soft lavender fill in the shadows to keep the character looking 'sweet'.
